decision: defer new runtime policy; evidence does not establish a distinct temporal coordination opportunity

existing_mechanisms.default_missions: Remembers objective; selects lead Miner; clears first friendly obstruction; assigns Scout to undisclosed obstruction; chooses capable support for disclosed combat obstruction. Recomputed each root.
existing_mechanisms.AI_MISSION_ESCORT: Before Miner attacks a known Bomb, targets a disclosed adjacent mobile recapture threat if another piece can beat it. Already a clear-guard-before-breach sequence.
existing_mechanisms.AI_MISSION_PRESERVE: Last Miner plus known Bombs triggers non-Miner reconnaissance and extra cost for Miner attacks on non-Bomb targets; not a distinct new persistent role.
existing_mechanisms.AI_PLAN_CYCLE: Tracks public actor identity, stalled objective and cooldown, but does not lock escort/Miner identities as a completed joint option.

mechanical_findings: 18legal quiet preparations all leave an adjacent known guard able to kill the Miner after its Bomb defuse. Threatening recapture imposes no zone of control. Explicit guard capture→Miner defuse→Flag capture works, but duplicates existingAI_MISSION_ESCORT.
future_option_if_new_evidence: A legitimate distinct option would retain specific Miner/escort identities across clear-guard, breach and finish phases, with public success/abort conditions and tactical interruptions. It must show a real missed executable handoff, not merely keep the same target longer or add an escort bonus.
future_budget: Possible state budget6–8bytes per army: objective, MinerID, escortID, phase, first blocker, termination/progress flags. At most3board floods, each100vertices/400neighbor checks, reusing existing mission-bank scratch. These are design bounds, not measured implementation/X16 timings.
future_control: Compare unchanged stateless role pipeline against identical pipeline with identity/phase memory, holding utilities and tactical overrides fixed. Freeze separateIDs before any games; no current implementation authorized by this evidence.

primary_source.title: Between MDPs and semi-MDPs: A framework for temporal abstraction in reinforcement learning
primary_source.use: Initiation, persistent internal policy and termination define a temporally extended option. This motivates explicit phases and interruption, but supplies no Stratego strength guarantee.

limits: One archived stress-family baseline cohort; no active campaign validation.
Captured or surviving rank labels are offline combat evidence; policy-eligible escort tests use only own ranks and previously disclosed enemy ranks.
This audit does not prove that hidden killers can be safely predicted or that sacrificing a Miner is always wrong.
A previously rejected score adjustment cannot be relabeled as temporal coordination.
